[[Rago's Flame Wand]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Rago Kindlerock]], a [[boss]] in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

== Stats ==
:[[Fire damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Fire Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of Fire Magic [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%) 
:Halves casting time of spells (Chance: 10%)
